context.stage: Stage F1 - Application Shell and Authentication

task.description: Design test specs and write E2E Playwright tests for Stage F1 SH-01 through SH-04. Write spec to tests/specs/SH-01-04.md. Write E2E test file web/tests/e2e/sh01-04.shell.e2e.spec.ts. Tests MUST be E2E against real backend (no MSW/mocks). Test scenarios: (1) SH-01: login with valid token shows workspace; login with invalid token shows error message; (2) SH-02: after login, 401 response navigates to /login?reason=session-expired; page reload navigates to /login?reason=session-expired (this may need to be a visual check or a manual test note since in-memory token cannot survive reload in test environment); (3) SH-03: TASK_WORKER role only sees My Tasks nav item; PLATFORM_ADMIN sees all items; (4) SH-04: header shows display_name and roles. NOTE: directive T-2 — no MSW. All HTTP-dependent tests MUST use real backend via BPM_TEST_BACKEND_URL env var (default http://localhost:8080). Pure utility tests (tokenUtils.ts) can be unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for tokenUtils.ts exist in web/src/auth/__tests__/tokenUtils.test.ts
Every MUST requirement has at least one E2E test
Test verdicts are visual (screen shows X after Y)

result.summary: Test specs and test code for SH-01, SH-02, SH-03, SH-04. Wrote 24 test cases: 12 unit tests (tokenUtils.test.ts: 7 for decodeTokenPayload, 5 for resolveDisplayName) and 12 E2E tests (sh01-04.shell.e2e.spec.ts: 4xSH-01, 2xSH-02, 3xSH-03, 3xSH-04). All 12 unit tests pass. E2E tests use page.route() only for /health/ready stub; no MSW or other mocking.
